{{Quote|She commands a phalanx for a rival syndic, one who doesn't approve of the changes I'm encouraging. And I know she wouldn't approve of you, either.|Assistant Syndic Soontir Fel|<ref name="Refugee" />}}
During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Ina'ganet'nuruodo]], [[Core name/Legends|core name]] "Ganet," was in charge of a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] '''phalanx''' loyal to a [[Unidentified syndic (Ina'ganet'nuruodo)|syndic]]. The phalanx was in opposition to [[Assistant Syndic]] [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]] and [[Syndic Mitth'raw'nuruodo's Household Phalanx]].<ref name="Refugee" />
